task_title: Clear threats before wounded Floor 1 NPC approaches

plan_review.notes: Retrospective separate-model plan review approved the surgical wounded-projectile NPC threat-clear design but required additional validation/process proof. Resolutions: (1) ran/recording exact Floor 1 release-leg sweep locally because no workflow_dispatch tool is available in-session; (2) kept the generic NPC branch behavior but added focused unit coverage and will rely on verify:fast/pr-prereqs for cross-floor regressions; (3) completed the 3-apple ledger stages before PR; (4) added a direct wounded projectile NPC-approach unit assertion.

findings.detail: The 'Files touched' section describes wounded-projectile threat clearing as if this PR introduced it. Diffing against base fb667f16 shows the woundedProjectile/RANGED_DEFENSIVE_HP_FRACTION check was already present (inherited unchanged from the separately-merged #2971); this diff only hoists that pre-existing computation earlier in the function and adds the genuinely new shouldExpandMeleeThreatClear branch. Remedy: reword the handoff to state the projectile behavior is pre-existing/inherited and that this PR's only functional addition is the wounded-melee radius expansion.

independent_grade.notes: Empirically verified all three claims: (1) ran the exact acceptance command and confirmed bow seed 35, baseball-bat seed 34, and throwing-knife seed 44 pass as real full headless-runner simulations, non-mocked; (2) temporarily reverted only the new shouldExpandMeleeThreatClear branch and confirmed the new it.each 'expands when wounded' unit test fails and the baseball-bat seed 34 headless regression fails ('death' instead of 'victory'), then restored the file and re-ran related NPC-approach/kite unit tests to confirm the hoisting refactor introduces no regression to the pre-existing projectile path; (3) confirmed via git diff against the stated base commit that the only functional change is the hoist plus the new melee-expansion branch, reusing an existing FARM_MIN_HEALTH_FRACTION constant already used elsewhere in the file. This is a surgical, minimal, correct diff for the stated task. The only legitimate residual issue is that the handoff doc's prose slightly overstates the projectile behavior as something this PR does, which is a documentation-accuracy nit, not a code defect, and does not block.
